{{Quotation|eye of the north|More than the glorified record keeper (as many of his fellow Vanguard see him), [[Artificer Mullenix|Mullenix]] is a man of many talents as well as a storehouse of information about the [[Ebon Vanguard]], their mission in the north, and the current state of affairs in [[Ascalon]]. Stationed at the [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]], Mullenix works closely with [[Captain Langmar]]'s aide, [[Gwen]], taking care of the base when the captain is out on missions.}}

==Dialogue==
;Eye of the North outpost
Before viewing [[The First Vision]] cinematic:
:''"You must be the adventurers from the south Gwen told me about. She's waiting for you in the [[Hall of Monuments]] at the rear of the Eye."''

After viewing The First Vision cinematic:
:''"I have kept a detailed record of every aspect of our mission in [[Charr Homelands|Charr lands]]. I have reports of vital Vanguard movements and military operations, and log listings of all supplies and personnel. I find my work quite exciting. Ask your questions. I can answer them all."

;Epilogue
:''"I have recorded your deeds so that we never forget the heroes who saved Tyria."''

;Ice Cliff Chasms
:''"I've come to record the minutes of this meeting for the books."''

;The Wedding
:''"I have a detailed transcript of the ceremony, should anyone need it."''

==Notes==
*Artificer Mullenix will greet you with [[Ebon Vanguard rank|high rank]] [[Ebon Vanguard#Voice responses|Ebon Vanguard responses]], regardless of your actual rank.
*It is possible that Artificer Mullenix is the same [[Adept Mullenix]] that appears in [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square]] in [[pre-searing Ascalon]].

==Trivia==
*Artificer Mullenix may be named after the game designer [[Joe Mullenix]].
